title: ExpenseReport
description: Structured output of Stage 2 (Extract), consumed by all downstream stages. This is the only interface between the LLM extractor and the rest of the system. Schema v0.9.0 (2026-07-21, EXT-12/CAT-07): item.date is now nullable -- an item whose date could not be extracted by either path carries date: null and the new blocking date_unverifiable flag, rather than a schema violation forcing a fabricated value. Schema v0.8.0 (2026-07-16, aligned to requirements v0.8.0): trip_id and per_diem_position.prior_approved_usd added for trip-linked per-diem aggregation across multiple reports (T10b). Schema v0.7.0 (2026-07-13, aligned to requirements v0.7.0): Slack-only intake (email conditional and manager_mismatch removed), per_diem_position added for day-level auto-cap audit trail.

trip_id.description: T10b/B3 (v0.8): identifies the trip this report belongs to, for per-diem aggregation across multiple reports on the same trip. Defaults to report_id when a trip is only ever claimed in a single report (all pre-T10b fixtures behave unchanged).

channel.description: SLK-01 (v0.7): Slack is the only v1 intake channel; enum extends additively when v2 email deeplink intake lands — downstream stages are channel-blind

sender_verified.description: Slack workspace SSO identity resolved to active employee in HR directory (CAP-SEC-01, v0.7)

manager_of_record_id.description: Resolved from HR system; the actual approver (APR-02). stated_manager fields retired with email intake (CAP-SEC-02, v0.7); permanently retired -- will not return in v2 (confirmed 2026-07-17, v2 email intake will not carry a stated-manager field)

high_cost_location.description: Unused in v1 (flat $75 per diem); retained additively for v2 high-cost city tiers

date.description: CAT-07 (v0.9.0): null when neither extraction path could find a date on the receipt at all (not merely hard to read) -- pairs with the date_unverifiable blocking flag, which forces manager review; downstream date-dependent checks (travel window, per-diem day-bucketing) skip null-date items rather than guessing.

amount.description: Positive for all lines except line_type=discount, which must be negative (EXT-05b); enforced by conditional below

currency.description: v1 is USD-only; field exists so v2 multi-currency is additive

receipt_ref.description: EXT-08: parent attachment for multi-line receipts; lines sharing a receipt_ref must sum to the receipt total

line_type.description: EXT-08/09: folio line descriptor (e.g. room_rate, breakfast, minibar); checked against non_reimbursable_line_types. EXT-05b (v0.6): 'discount' marks a negative line (promo, coupon); reimbursement is always net-paid

check_in.description: CAT-08 v2 (v0.9.6): accommodation folio check-in date, read from the folio face by BOTH extraction paths (OCR and vision). With check_out it derives the per-night divisor (nights = check_out - check_in), replacing the employee-entered nights so the divisor can no longer be self-reported. Trusted only when both readers agree on the stay range; a disagreement reuses the blocking extraction_mismatch flag (no new flag) and the cap falls to the conservative nights=1 divisor. Ignored for non-accommodation items.

check_out.description: CAT-08 v2 (v0.9.6): accommodation folio check-out date; pairs with check_in (see check_in). nights = check_out - check_in, floored at 1.

nights.description: DEPRECATED for the cap divisor as of CAT-08 v2 (v0.9.6): nights is now derived from folio check_in/check_out read by both paths, not self-reported. Retained additively for backward compatibility and audit; apply_accommodation_cap no longer reads it. Ignored for non-accommodation items.

combined_line.description: EXT-08a (v0.6): line the receipt does not itemize (e.g. 'Room rate + Breakfast'); never split, categorized by dominant component

amount_raw.description: EXT-05a (v0.6): verbatim amount string pre-normalization (e.g. '105.00a'); preserved for audit and corpus analysis

status.description: CAP-04: no-proof items stay in the record but are never paid. EXT-09: non-reimbursable folio lines recorded, never paid. CAP-08: withdrawn items retained for audit, excluded from all calculations.

attendees.description: Required for meal_group and client_entertainment (CAP-06, CAT-03). Employee emails for internal attendees; 'Name — Organization' strings allowed for external attendees.

correction.description: v0.9.4 (VER-03/REV-04): an in-place human correction to an extracted field. human_value is authoritative and re-runs all policy checks; ai_value is preserved for audit and as the REV-04 labeled pair. Presence also emits informational field_corrected; an employee amount correction matching neither extraction path emits blocking correction_mismatch.

ai_value.description: original extracted value (number for amount, string for date/category)

actor_id.description: authenticated identity of the correcting human

injection_suspects.description: Verbatim instruction-like text found in inputs (EXT-SEC-02). Data only, never executed.

verification.description: VER-01..04: employee attestation and guarded corrections

pii_redaction.description: CAP-SEC-05: counts/types only, never redacted values

per_diem_position.description: CAT-02 (v0.7); T10b (v0.8) added trip-linked aggregation. Day-level per diem auto-cap audit trail. Key = calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). Present for every day with meal_individual spend; excluded_overage > 0 implies an over_per_diem informational flag.

prior_approved_usd.description: T10b: meal total already reimbursed by other *approved* reports for this trip/day, captured as of when this report was processed (replayability snapshot, EVAL-01). Only approved reports contribute -- a sibling report still in human review never suppresses this one's allowance. 0 when this is the only report for the trip/day, or no sibling had been approved yet.

prior_approved_from_reports.description: T10b audit trail: which specific prior report(s) contributed to prior_approved_usd, and how much each contributed. Empty when prior_approved_usd is 0.

included_usd.description: Recomputed from included items (PAY-04), never taken from employee's stated total
